summary: Public home and service pages. Seven Phase 1 services — membership, registration sheet, pedigree, kennel, mating permit, puppy card and the trusted-veterinarian visit — are described in a code catalogue with their definition, audience, prerequisites taken from the existing lock wording, steps, documents, questions and one call to action each. No figure is written on any page: every fee is the key of a managed product_setting read at request time, an unconfigured tariff is shown as unconfigured rather than as zero or free, and a service Hamzist does not charge for says so and shows the approved pricing notice instead. No page promises a time, a duration or an appointment, because §18 allows a time only where real data exists and none does; each page states plainly that Hamzist gives no appointment. Every call to action points at the guarded Phase 1 route that already performs the service, so a public page never becomes a second, unguarded way in — an anonymous visitor clicking it lands on sign-in with the exact next path. No table was added: the catalogue is fixed product text, not operator data, so nothing public was parallelled with a Phase 1 entity and no migration was needed. The home page was rebuilt to §5 with real data — value message, the services, how it works, a search box and the directory lists, featured breeds, the latest article and news, published associations and clubs, and counts taken from published records at request time — where every block disappears entirely when its data does not exist, so no empty shelf or invented number appears. A new faqLd emits FAQ structured data only from the questions a page actually renders, and /services joins the sitemap without becoming a §4 navigation section.

As in the previous prompts, npm run build was run before the browser suites because the harness serves the existing .next. Last full browser run 103/103 at commit 7c74577.

limitations: The service catalogue is fixed product text in code and cannot be edited from the panel; wiring it to the Phase 2 CMS is left for a later prompt rather than adding a table that would parallel Phase 1 entities.
The puppy-card call to action points at /mating because /puppy-cards has no list page: the real flow opens from the mating case and its litter.
LOCK_REGISTRATION_SHEET_REQUIRED still points at /registration/batch, which does not exist under app/; it is Phase 1 wording left untouched here, and the service pages use the routes that do exist.
Home statistics are counts of published records only; no other aggregate or performance figure was invented.
Browser and unit/DB checks were targeted by user instruction; unaffected suites were last run in full at commit 7c74577.
Visual fidelity of the home and service pages is UNVERIFIED: no Phase 2 Figma frame is in the sources.
